audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 read 'Skill' while its own content why says Pantheon can stun-and-burst before Sylas has an answer, and both item rows read Pantheon while whys[5] and whys[6] describe Sylas out-damaging and out-scaling him.
audit.why: The packet chart reads Pantheon / Pantheon / Pantheon / Skill / Sylas / Skill / Sylas, which is also what the content prose already argues and what a 52.02% Sylas win rate implies: Pantheon owns the first three levels, Sylas takes level 6 and the two-item window.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 6, first item and 2+ items flipped in matched phases[].side + win[] pairs, ratings moved, and the two contradicting why lines rewritten.

audit.why: Four spikes, correctly ordered: his level 1-3 stun-and-burst, level 6 Hijack, Riftmaker, and Sylas's two-item reclaim. The level 6 entry needed only the cooldown asymmetry added, which is what makes the steal a spike.
audit.corrected: No spike text edits; whys[4] carries the corrected cooldown comparison.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault is never mentioned anywhere on the page. whys[1] says Shield Vault 'costs no resources and resets off kills and assists'. whys[4] says Hijack makes Pantheon lose his ultimate. Four fields say Abduct stuns.
audit.why: Aegis Assault (E, 400 range, 22/21/20/19/18s) makes Pantheon invulnerable to damage from the front while he channels — it is the single ability that blanks a Sylas rotation, and it is also his longest cooldown by a wide margin. Shield Vault costs 55 mana on a 13/12/11/10/9s cooldown. Hijack casts a copy; Pantheon keeps Grand Starfall, but his is 150-180s against Hijack's 80/55/30s, and that gap is the real edge. Abduct is a chain pull with no stun.
audit.corrected: Aegis Assault written in as what his E actually does and why you attack it from behind or after it; Shield Vault's real cost and cooldown used; the Hijack claim rewritten to the cooldown asymmetry; stun claims removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d treats a spent Shield Vault as an open-ended guarantee and never gives its length.
audit.why: Shield Vault is 13/12/11/10/9s — long enough to matter, short enough that a player who dawdles after baiting it gets stunned anyway. Aegis Assault's 18-22s is the longer and more punishable window, and nothing on the page told the reader that.
audit.corrected: Real Shield Vault window written into dosFull[2].d; Aegis Assault added to wants.foe[2].

edits.before: Q poke is your only level-1 tool — chain it on his step-ups but don't force anything; your power arrives with levels.
edits.after: He has Mortal Will from the first minute — an empowered Comet Spear on your step-up costs 25 mana and you have no answer.

edits.before: Riftmaker spike — your full chain with the W heal wins almost any extended 1v1 that starts even.
edits.after: Riftmaker heals through his chip, but Aegis Assault blanks your burst from the front — bait it first.

edits.before: Pantheon spends Shield Vault (Stun) early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Pantheon spends Shield Vault early — that is a 9-13 second window and it is all you get.

edits.before: Engaging with both E charges spent — no shield, no stun, and you're a melee mage standing in the open.
edits.after: Engaging with both E charges spent — Abduct only pulls you in, and a melee mage has no exit without it.

edits.before: Engaging with both E charges spent — no shield, no stun, and you're a melee mage standing in the open.
edits.after: Abduct does not stun — it chains you to the front of his shield, which is the side nothing gets through.

edits.before: His W Shield Vault costs no resources and resets off kills and assists — at level 2 he can still chain stun into Q burst faster than your new E charges let you respond.
edits.after: His W Shield Vault is a 600-range point-click stun on a 13s cooldown — at level 2 he chains it into Comet Spear faster than your new E charges let you respond.

edits.before: Hijack Grand Starfall at 6 and he loses his only team-fight ultimate while you gain global presence — the in-lane 1v1 tips your way when you chain E2 into W on his Shield Vault cooldown.
edits.after: Hijack copies Grand Starfall at 6 — he keeps his own, but his costs 150-180s while yours returns in 80, so the 1v1 tips your way when you chain in on Shield Vault's cooldown.

edits.before: Snowball the early lead and translate it into roams before you can stabilize at 6
edits.after: Meet your burst with Aegis Assault — it blanks damage from the front for the whole channel

notes: Left alone deliberately: whys[2]'s claim that his empowered Q is 'over 40% of your HP in one button press'. It may well be right, but nothing in the kits gives damage numbers and I would not ship a figure I cannot source. Recorded here so it can be checked rather than silently trusted.
